description: Sub-workflow for one message to the Lark bot, called by 'Content agent: lark'. Re-reads the message from the Lark API. Direct messages are accepted from the owner (the first person to message the bot); in groups only the team chat is served, and only messages that @mention the bot or start with a /command. /link by the owner in a group makes it the team chat, where everyone is equal. Instant commands (/help, /status, /story, /inspiring) run without AI; /rule, /goal, /offers, /plan, /draft and /review go to the agent as focused tasks; anything else goes to the agent as chat, with the thread's history. Pictures replied to a draft card attach to that post; other screenshots in a direct message are saved as inspiration.
name: Content agent: lark message
